business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and sells cement, concrete and related products in Mainland China.
business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly from sales of cement, clinker, ready-mixed concrete and related products; cement accounted for 83% of 2024 revenue.
business_notes: 2024 revenue fell 21% mainly because average selling prices declined.
2024 gross margin fell to 10% from 14% because product price reductions exceeded cost reductions.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year profit fell from RMB420.072m to RMB106.088m to a RMB263.682m loss. Operating cash flow stayed positive, but 2024 free cash after PPE purchase was close to zero and cash flow includes working-capital movements. Cement is cyclical and the latest full year loss requires a large denominator haircut.

gaps: Annual report does not split cash by parent company versus individual PRC subsidiaries for dividend/extraction assessment.
Deposits are disclosed as original maturity over three months, but exact maturities beyond that bucket are not fully disclosed.
Capital expenditure is not split into maintenance versus growth capex; median PPE purchase is used as a conservative maintenance proxy.
2024 market capitalization is not disclosed in the annual report; this analysis uses the rough-screen market capitalization from config/input.json.
